label: Required depths
subgoals: Assign the target depth to every primary output
Give each LUT leaf one less than the smallest requirement of its users
Traverse the cover in reverse topological order

label: Slack and where it comes from
section: Slack and where it comes from
subgoals: Compute arrival depth from the node's LUT inputs
Subtract arrival from required depth to get slack
Raise the target depth to create slack everywhere

label: Spending slack on cheaper cuts
subgoals: Filter candidate cuts by the node's required depth
Pick the legal cut with the smallest area flow or exact area
Reselect the cover and recompute required depths after each pass
